name: gyneconomy
description: Gyneconomy — a single-file reading companion to the book Mrs. Market.

scripts.test:tools: node test/season.test.js && node test/cycle.test.js && node test/series.test.js && node test/fetch-live.test.js && node test/fetch-fred-history.test.js && node test/tag-versions.test.js && node test/load-order.test.js && node test/hygiene.test.js && node test/sw.test.js
scripts.email: test "$(grep -cE '[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}' index.html)" = 0 && echo 'ok: no email address in markup'
scripts.check: npm run build:check && npm run email && node tools/uncomment.js --check && node tools/load-order.js && node tools/hygiene.js && npm run typecheck && npm run map:check && npm run comp:check && npm run test:tools && npm run test:unit
scripts.check:slow: npm test && npm run a11y:check && npm run sources:check
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:slow
